newsitem.title: USA: Northern Maine digs out from late snowfall.
newsitem.headline: Northern Maine digs out from late snowfall.

text.p: Northern Maine residents dug out Tuesday from a late-season storm that left some communities with more a half-foot of heavy wet snow.
National Weather Service forecasters said 7.6 inches fell at the NWS station in Caribou, and up to 9.5 inches on hilltop areas of neighbouring Presque Isle.
The storm, which moved eastward into New Brunswick, caused scattered power outages but no major traffic accidents were reported.
The snow was expected to melt relatively quickly with temperatures forecast to climb well above freezing by Wednesday afternoon, according to weather service officials.
